review.reason: The greens read as single natural putting surfaces, and all three fairways have visible stripes. However, the mapped T1 is not visible, and added trees crowd the hole 1 tee-to-landing corridor, obscuring the intended route in the overview.

issues.detail: The mapped T1 is missing; its expected location is obscured by trees.
issues.consequence: Viewers cannot identify the starting point for hole 1.

issues.detail: Added tree crowns crowd the corridor from T1 toward hole 1's first fairway landing area.
issues.consequence: The overview makes the intended tee-to-landing route appear blocked.
